extracted.name: Shredded Apple Carrot Salad
extracted.description: This apple carrot salad recipe is a quick and colorful side dish perfect for summer picnics.
ingredient_lines: 1 Granny Smith apple, cored and shredded
instruction_lines: Heat a skillet over medium heat; pour sesame seeds into the hot skillet. Cook, stirring often, until sesame seeds are lightly browned and fragrant, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Mix carrots, apple, toasted sesame seeds, and parsley together in a bowl.

Whisk lemon juice, vinegar, sugar, garlic, salt, and pepper together in a separate bowl; slowly drizzle safflower oil into lemon juice mixture while continuing to whisk. Pour dressing over carrot mixture; toss to coat.
